pois.label: 中继母舱
pois.detail: 1.8×1.8×2.6 m 三轴稳定母舱，金/银多层隔热(MLI)包覆，棱边加强筋。定点火星静止轨道(半径 20,428 km / 赤道面上空 17,032 km)，对火星天底(+Z)保持指向，轨道周期 = 火星恒星日 24h37m，相对地面静止。3 主 + 1 热备份星，星座对赤道 ±71° 纬度带 10° 最低仰角连续覆盖，极区为盲区。±71°@10° 在各星星下点经度严格成立；两星接缝经度上 10° 仰角覆盖边在纬度 48°，71° 处为 0° 仰角口径(com-gap s02 复核)。极区盲区已由 com-polar-01 三星圆极轨环闭合(双帽 100%，切换边界 ±71°，重叠带 45°–71°)。
pois.detail_en: A 1.8 x 1.8 x 2.6 m three-axis-stabilized bus wrapped in gold/silver multi-layer insulation with reinforced edges. It holds an areostationary slot (orbit radius 20,428 km, 17,032 km above the equator), keeps its +Z face on the Mars nadir, and circles once per Martian sidereal day (24h 37m), so it hangs still over the ground. Three active satellites plus one hot spare cover the +/-71 deg latitude band continuously down to 10 deg elevation; the poles are blind. The +/-71 deg at 10 deg figure holds strictly at each sub-satellite longitude; on the seam longitudes between satellites the 10 deg coverage edge sits at latitude 48 deg, with 71 deg being the 0 deg elevation bound (com-gap s02 recheck). The polar blind zone itself is now closed by the com-polar-01 three-satellite circular polar ring (both caps 100%, handover boundary +/-71 deg, overlap band 45-71 deg).

specs.构型: 三轴稳定 · 天底指向
specs.质量: 干重 1265 kg(含 20% 裕度)· 湿重 1362 kg

specs_en.Mass: 1265 kg dry (20% margin included), 1362 kg wet

pois.physics: 辐射环境:火星无全球磁场 → 无范艾伦俘获带——TID 由太阳质子事件(SPE)+ 银河宇宙线(GCR)构成,而地球 GEO 同屏蔽下俘获电子贡献 ~50–100 krad;火星静止轨道反而温和 ~10×。质子过铝靠电离损失(Bethe-Bloch):低能端在首毫米内以布拉格峰沉积(剂量-深度曲线 0.75 mm 处的隆起),高能端指数尾深穿。GCR 对 TID 贡献仅 ~0.1 krad/15 yr,但其重离子主导单粒子效应(SEE),需锁存保护电路而非更厚屏蔽——屏蔽对 GCR 几乎无效。
pois.physics_en: Radiation environment: Mars has no global magnetic field, so there are no trapped Van Allen belts - total dose comes from solar proton events and galactic cosmic rays alone. At Earth GEO, trapped electrons behind the same shielding add another 50-100 krad, which makes an areostationary Mars slot roughly 10x milder. Protons crossing aluminium lose energy by ionization (Bethe-Bloch): the low-energy end dumps its Bragg peak inside the first millimetre (the bump at 0.75 mm in the dose-depth curve), the high-energy tail punches straight through. GCR contributes only ~0.1 krad over 15 years, but its heavy ions drive single-event effects - that calls for latch-up protection circuitry, not thicker walls, because shielding barely touches GCR.
sim: 链路预算：静止高度下单跳时延 57 ms(天底)–65 ms(10° 仰角覆盖边缘,斜距 19,565 km)；星座 120° 相位使任一 ±71° 内地面点始终 ≥1 星可见

辐射输运实解(Geant4/GATE 9.4.1,QGSP_BIC_EMY,2×10⁵ 质子蒙卡):SPE 指数谱(E₀=27 MeV,10–300 MeV,King 型)入射 20 mm 铝板,40 层剂量-深度;按 15 年任务通量 Φ(>10 MeV)=5×10¹⁰ p/cm²(1.52 AU,含裕度假设)标定 → 2 mm 铝后 11.2 krad、4 mm 后 7.1 krad、10 mm 后 2.9 krad。取设计裕度 RDM×2:4 mm 等效屏蔽下需求 ~14 krad → 耐辐射级(30 krad)器件即可,无需全 rad-hard——这是火星轨道相对地球 GEO 的真实工程红利(平板正入射近似,未计 4π 自屏蔽,偏保守)

质量预算(系统三大预算最后一块,每行都从本项目自己的仿真反推):太阳翼 150 kg(面密度 3.5 kg/m² 取自星蚀瞬态模型热容)、反射面 85 kg(热弹判决的 CFRP 夹层)、辐射屏蔽 23 kg(Geant4 的 4 mm 壁)、辐射器 40 kg(评审修正后 ~9 m²)、推进剂 97 kg(位保积分 166 m/s 含处置)。干重 1054 + 20% 裕度 = 1265 kg,湿重 1362 kg,推进剂占比仅 7.1%(电推可再砍半)。整个星座 4 星 ≈ 5.4 t——一发重型运载的 TMI 运力内,星座可单射入轨
sim_en: Link geometry: one-way delay from the slot is 57 ms at nadir and 65 ms at the 10 deg elevation edge (slant range 19,565 km); with the constellation phased 120 deg apart, any ground point inside +/-71 deg always has at least one satellite in view.

Radiation transport solved for real (Geant4/GATE 9.4.1, QGSP_BIC_EMY, 2x10^5 proton Monte Carlo): a King-type exponential SPE spectrum (E0 = 27 MeV, 10-300 MeV) into a 20 mm aluminium slab scored in 40 depth layers, normalized to a 15-year mission fluence of 5x10^10 p/cm2 above 10 MeV (1.52 AU, margin included) - 11.2 krad behind 2 mm, 7.1 krad behind 4 mm, 2.9 krad behind 10 mm. With a design margin of x2, the 4 mm case asks for ~14 krad parts, so rad-tolerant (30 krad) devices are enough and full rad-hard is unnecessary - the real engineering dividend of Mars orbit over Earth GEO. (Normal incidence on a flat slab, no credit taken for 4-pi self-shielding: conservative.)

Mass budget (the last of the three system budgets, every line back-derived from this project's own simulations): solar array 150 kg (3.5 kg/m^2 areal density taken from the eclipse transient model), reflectors 85 kg (the CFRP sandwich the thermoelastic run demanded), radiation shielding 23 kg (Geant4's 4 mm wall), radiators 40 kg (~9 m^2 after the review correction), propellant 97 kg (166 m/s of station keeping including disposal). Dry mass 1054 kg + 20% margin = 1265 kg, wet 1362 kg, propellant only 7.1% of it (electric propulsion would halve that). The whole four-satellite constellation is ~5.4 t - inside a single heavy-lift trans-Mars injection, so it can go up in one shot.

pois.label: 对火面天线(Ka/X)
pois.detail: 2 副 Ø3 m 抛物面反射器，白色反射面 + 馈源杆 + 副反射器(卡塞格林)，指向火星天底(+Z)，为地面着陆器/巡视器/轨道器提供前向指令与返向数据中继。Ka 波段(32 GHz)高速返向 + X 波段(8.4 GHz)兼容传统用户与应急。
pois.detail_en: Two dia. 3 m parabolic reflectors - white dish, feed boom, Cassegrain subreflector - staring down the Mars nadir (+Z) to carry forward commands and return data for landers, rovers and orbiters. Ka band (32 GHz) does the high-rate return; X band (8.4 GHz) keeps legacy users and emergency modes alive.

specs.波段: Ka 32 GHz(高速) + X 8.4 GHz(兼容)

specs_en.Gain: 58.2 dBi at Ka (HFSS + PO solved), ~45 dBi at X
specs_en.Return rate: up to 150 Mbps to surface users at Ka

pois.physics: 衍射:远场方向图 = 孔径场的二维傅里叶变换。均匀照明圆孔 → 艾里图样 (2J₁(x)/x)²,第一零点在 1.22λ/D——与光学望远镜的瑞利判据同一物理;增益 G=4πAₑ𝒻𝒻/λ²。口径效率 η<1 的物理来源:照明锥削 + 馈源溢出 + 副反/支杆遮挡 + 面形误差(Ruze 定律:增益 ∝ exp[−(4πσ/λ)²])。Ka(λ=9.4 mm)要 σ≈λ/50≈0.19 mm RMS 面精——这就是 Ka 抛物面难做的物理根子。
pois.physics_en: Diffraction: the far-field pattern is the two-dimensional Fourier transform of the aperture field. A uniformly illuminated circular aperture gives the Airy pattern (2J1(x)/x)^2 with its first null at 1.22 lambda/D - the same physics as the Rayleigh criterion in optical telescopes - and gain G = 4 pi Aeff / lambda^2. Aperture efficiency falls below unity through illumination taper, feed spillover, subreflector and strut blockage, and surface error (Ruze: gain scales as exp[-(4 pi sigma / lambda)^2]). At Ka (lambda = 9.4 mm) that demands sigma ~ lambda/50 ~ 0.19 mm RMS - the physical reason Ka reflectors are hard to build.
sim: 口径-增益：G≈η(πD/λ)²，D=3 m、η=0.6，Ka(λ=9.4 mm)得 57.8 dBi；仿真波束 0.226° 下天底半功率覆盖直径仅 ~67 km(评审修正:原写 240 km 系 0.4° 手算波束的零点-零点直径,双重过时)，窄成这样意味着单址波束须逐用户跟踪,用户切换由星座调度

频段取舍(最肥的一处)：火星现役中继(MRO/TGO/Odyssey)心脏是 UHF Proximity-1(401/437 MHz)——全向、鲁棒、免指向，但速率仅 ~2 Mbps 量级。本星选 Ka 高增益换 10~100× 速率，代价是①用户须带可动天线②窄波束要求高精度指向③低仰角长路径敏感。(注:尘暴对 Ka 近乎透明——尘粒 ~µm ≪ λ=9.4 mm,处深瑞利区,路径衰减 <0.1 dB;尘暴真正打击的是光伏出力与光学链路,而非 Ka 吸收,我此前『尘暴敏感』的措辞过重)故实配 Ka(高速主用) + X(应急/兼容低能力用户)双馈，弱用户仍可退回宽波束

全波+物理光学仿真(Ansys HFSS 2026R1,非公式):32 GHz 锥喇叭馈源实解 17.96 dBi(HPBW 24°),按等效 f/D=0.8 照射(卡塞格伦:物理主面 f/D=0.4,副反射器放大出长等效焦距——几何模型里的浅碗即主面),边缘照射 −16 dB;口径积分二次方向图得 58.2 dBi、HPBW 0.226°、首旁瓣 −27 dB、口径效率 0.68(未含副反/撑杆遮挡 −0.1~−0.5 dB 与馈源相位差,真实约 57.5–58 dBi)。修正了手算两处:η 实为 0.68(非假设 0.6);波束 0.226°(手算 0.4° 偏宽近 2×)→ 收紧姿控指向预算(见 adcs 卡)
输入匹配(HFSS 28–36 GHz 扫频):S11 @32 GHz = −26.6 dB、VSWR 1.1,整个扫频段均 <−10 dB(带宽 ≥25%,实际带边未扫到、更宽)。失配损耗仅 0.01 dB → 实现增益 ≈ 增益,TWTA 功率几乎全辐射——这一条『证实』而非『修正』了 EIRP 预算(见 rf 卡)

热弹实解(COMSOL 传热+固体力学耦合,通厚 20 K + 横向 ±15 K 梯度,293 K 装调):材料选择被解出来了——铝碗热弯 σ=5.66 mm,Ruze 损 −250 dB,天线直接报废;即便完美调焦,剩余 0.144 mm 也独吞整个 0.15 mm 面精预算。CFRP(α=1 ppm/K)未调焦仅 0.246 mm(−0.47 dB),一次性焦距修正后 0.006 mm(−0.0003 dB,可忽略)→ Ka 反射面必须 CFRP,且 σ=0.15 mm 的 Ruze 预算实为『制造公差』——热变形贡献可忽略,这就是该假设成立的原因
sim_en: Aperture-gain: G ~ eta (pi D / lambda)^2 gives 57.8 dBi for D = 3 m and eta = 0.6 at Ka (lambda 9.4 mm). At the solved 0.226 deg beamwidth the half-power footprint at nadir is only ~67 km across (review correction: the earlier 240 km was the null-to-null diameter of a hand-computed 0.4 deg beam, wrong twice over). A pencil that narrow means single-access beams must track each user, with handover run by constellation scheduling.

Band trade (the richest one on this satellite): today's Mars relays (MRO, TGO, Odyssey) live on UHF Proximity-1 at 401/437 MHz - omnidirectional, robust, no pointing needed, but capped near 2 Mbps. This satellite buys 10-100x the rate with high-gain Ka and pays for it with (1) users needing a steerable antenna, (2) tight pointing for a narrow beam, (3) sensitivity to long low-elevation paths. Dust storms, note, are nearly transparent at Ka: grains of ~um are far smaller than the 9.4 mm wavelength, deep in the Rayleigh regime, so path attenuation stays under 0.1 dB. Storms hurt photovoltaic output and optical links, not Ka absorption - my earlier 'dust-sensitive' wording was overstated. Hence the dual feed: Ka for the high-rate service, X for emergencies and low-capability users, who can always fall back to the wide beam.

Full-wave plus physical optics (Ansys HFSS 2026R1, solved rather than assumed): the 32 GHz conical horn feed comes out at 17.96 dBi with a 24 deg beamwidth; illuminating at an equivalent f/D of 0.8 (Cassegrain - the physical main dish is f/D 0.4 and the subreflector magnifies it into a long equivalent focal length, so the shallow bowl in the geometry model is the main reflector) gives a -16 dB edge taper. Aperture integration then yields 58.2 dBi, 0.226 deg beamwidth, -27 dB first sidelobe and 0.68 aperture efficiency (subreflector and strut blockage, -0.1 to -0.5 dB, and feed phase error are not included; the honest figure is 57.5-58 dBi). Two hand calculations were corrected: eta is really 0.68 rather than the assumed 0.6, and the beam is 0.226 deg where the hand estimate said 0.4 deg - nearly 2x too wide - which tightened the attitude-control pointing budget (see the ADCS card).

Input match (HFSS swept 28-36 GHz): S11 at 32 GHz is -26.6 dB with VSWR 1.1, and the entire sweep stays below -10 dB (bandwidth >=25%, and the band edges were never reached, so it is wider still). Mismatch loss is 0.01 dB, so realized gain equals gain and essentially all TWTA power radiates - this one confirmed rather than corrected the EIRP budget (see the RF card).

Thermoelastic solution (COMSOL heat transfer coupled to solid mechanics, 20 K through-thickness plus +/-15 K lateral gradient, assembled at 293 K): the material choice fell out of the solver. An aluminium dish bends to sigma = 5.66 mm RMS, a Ruze loss of -250 dB - the antenna is simply dead; even after perfect refocusing the residual 0.144 mm eats the whole 0.15 mm surface budget by itself. CFRP (alpha = 1 ppm/K) reaches only 0.246 mm unfocused (-0.47 dB) and 0.006 mm after a one-time focus correction (-0.0003 dB, negligible). So a Ka reflector has to be CFRP, and the 0.15 mm Ruze budget is really a manufacturing tolerance - thermal distortion contributes nothing, which is exactly why that assumption holds.

pois.label: 对地天线(X 波段)
pois.detail: 1 副 Ø2.5 m 金色网面抛物面，双轴万向架可指向地球，承担深空回传(DTE)。地火距离 0.5–2.67 AU 随会合变化，速率据距离自适应；会合期(2.67 AU)为最恶劣链路。母舱汇聚火星侧全部用户数据后经此下行至 DSN/深空站。合日期由 com-l4-01 经日火 L4 中继兜底：全断 0 天，回程 ~1.4 Mbps 窄带应急信道；本星 2.5 m 对地碟合日期可改指 L4 作为 ~0.3 kbps 应急备份路径。
pois.detail_en: A dia. 2.5 m gold-mesh parabola on a two-axis gimbal, pointed at Earth for the direct-to-Earth downlink. Earth-Mars range swings between 0.5 and 2.67 AU over the synodic cycle and the data rate adapts to it; conjunction, at 2.67 AU, is the worst case. Every byte the Mars side collects funnels through the bus and leaves the system here, bound for the deep-space network. During solar conjunction the outage is backstopped by com-l4-01 relaying via Sun-Mars L4: zero blackout days, with a ~1.4 Mbps narrowband emergency return channel; this satellite's own 2.5 m Earth dish can repoint to L4 in conjunction season as a ~0.3 kbps emergency backup path.

specs.波段: X 8.4 GHz 下行 / 7.2 GHz 上行
specs.指向: 双轴万向 · 地球跟踪
specs.掩星副产品: 切点 = 槽位 ±80.4° · 172 sols/火星年

specs_en.Return rate: ~0.2 Mbps at 2.67 AU to ~5 Mbps at 0.5 AU (adaptive)

physics: 逆平方不是'损耗':点源辐射进 4πr² 球面,功率密度 ∝1/r²,是几何稀释、能量守恒——没有能量被吸收。接收端只截到 Aₑ𝒻𝒻/(4πr²) 一小片,这才是 283 dB 的来历。
Friis 的 λ² 陷阱:(λ/4πr)² 里的 λ² 并非'频率越高损耗越大'——它来自 Aₑ𝒻𝒻=G·λ²/4π。固定物理口径下频率越高增益越高,λ² 被抵消;故'定口径对定口径'链路反而频率越高越好。
日凌是等离子体物理:日冕为磁化等离子体,三效应皆 ∝1/f²——群延迟色散(∝TEC/f²)、湍流密度不均引起的幅度/相位闪烁、法拉第旋转(∝∫nₑB∥dl/f²)。故 X→Ka 反而更抗日凌(恰与抗尘暴的取舍相反)。
physics_en: The inverse square law is not a 'loss': a point source spreads its power over a 4 pi r^2 sphere, so power density falls as 1/r^2 by geometry and energy conservation - nothing absorbs anything. The receiver only intercepts Aeff/(4 pi r^2) of that sphere, and this is where the 283 dB comes from.

The lambda^2 trap in Friis: the lambda^2 inside (lambda/4 pi r)^2 does not mean higher frequencies lose more - it comes from Aeff = G lambda^2 / 4 pi. At a fixed physical aperture, gain rises with frequency and cancels it exactly, so for fixed-aperture-to-fixed-aperture links higher frequency is always better.

Solar conjunction is plasma physics: the corona is a magnetized plasma and all three effects scale as 1/f^2 - group-delay dispersion (as TEC/f^2), amplitude and phase scintillation from turbulent density structure, and Faraday rotation (as the path integral of ne B over f^2). Moving X -> Ka therefore improves conjunction robustness, exactly opposite to the dust-storm trade.
sim: 链路闭合(评审修正,原写 ~2 Mbps 高了 ~10 dB):C/N₀ = EIRP(13 dBW+45 dBi) − 283 dB + G/T 50 + 228.6 = 53.6 dB-Hz → 会合期(2.67 AU)编码后净速率 ~0.2 Mbps;0.5 AU 近距改善 14.5 dB → ~5 Mbps。参照:MRO(100 W X + 3 m HGA,比本星强 8.6 dB)最远也仅 0.5–1 Mbps 级。要会合期 2 Mbps 须 70 m 站/组阵或 Ka-DTE 加码
日凌(上合):~779 天会合周期一次,日-地-探(SEP)角<~2° 时日冕等离子体压垮链路 → 全断 ~2 周、SEP<5° 降级数周;此间对地不可下行但对火仍在收数 → 星上数百 Gb 存储缓冲关键流 + 地面同步限收削峰,凌后回灌

任务级数据流仿真(逐时推进一个 780 天会合周期,真实地球/火星几何 → 距离/SEP → 变速率):全周期可交付 65 Tb(均值 0.965 Mbps);日凌全断 14.4 天由几何自然涌现(与'~2 周'声明吻合 ✓)。缓存尺寸规则被仿真闭环:全断期收 0.35 Mbps 关键流 → 峰值 434.7 Gb,恰卡进 500 Gb 存储(13% 裕度);因日凌紧邻最远距,积压要 ~70 天才排完——排空慢不是故障,是几何
反面教材(旧卡片的 2 Mbps 恒定采集假设):缓存第 ~70 天即钉死顶格,全周期丢 84.8 Tb——比可交付总量 65 Tb 还多。评审修正的那 10 dB,在任务级等价于'整个任务的科学产出'

掩星副产品的落点几何(数值解与解析式逐位互验):静止星在火星固连系不动,但在惯性系每个火星日绕火一周,故当地球赤纬 |δ|<9.64° 时每 sol 被火星遮挡一次,进/出各得一次临边探测——对地链路的射电科学副产品。切点经度恒为槽位 ±80.4°(δ=0)至 ±79.8°(δ=3.07°),几乎只由槽位决定;切点纬度只由 δ 决定,按 arcsin[(r/R)·c·sinδ] 在一个蚀季内从赤道扫到 78°N。结论:77.4°E 的星自己采样 157.8°E 与 357.0°E 的空气,采不到脚下的城市;要采城市必须另有一星坐在 77.4±79.8° 上。157.2°E 那颗的东支切点轨迹沿城市子午线爬升(δ=0 → 0.0°N/76.84°E;δ=3.07° → 18.40°N/77.37°E 精确命中 Jezero;δ=9° → 67.1°N/92.7°E),蚀季占火星年 25.7%(≈172 sols),每 sol 一次城市子午线临边廓线。模型口径:直线掠射几何(火星表面折射率 ~3.6 N,弯曲角 ~0.009°,对槽位选取可忽略),中性大气参考高度 25 km,未含电离层
sim_en: Link closure (review correction; the earlier ~2 Mbps was ~10 dB optimistic): C/N0 = EIRP (13 dBW + 45 dBi) - 283 dB + G/T 50 + 228.6 = 53.6 dB-Hz, which after coding gives ~0.2 Mbps net at conjunction (2.67 AU); at 0.5 AU the 14.5 dB improvement takes it to ~5 Mbps. For scale, MRO (100 W X band on a 3 m high-gain antenna, 8.6 dB stronger than this satellite) manages only 0.5-1 Mbps at its worst. Getting 2 Mbps at conjunction would need a 70 m station, arraying, or a Ka upgrade on the DTE.

Conjunction: once per ~779-day synodic cycle, when the Sun-Earth-probe angle falls below ~2 deg, coronal plasma crushes the link - a full outage of ~2 weeks with degraded service for several weeks below 5 deg. Through it the satellite cannot downlink but keeps collecting from Mars, so several hundred Gb of on-board storage buffers the critical streams while the ground throttles intake, and everything drains afterwards.

Mission-level data-flow simulation (a full 780-day synodic cycle advanced hour by hour, real Earth and Mars geometry driving range, SEP angle and rate): 65 Tb delivered per cycle, mean 0.965 Mbps. The 14.4-day full outage emerges from the geometry on its own and matches the '~2 weeks' claim. Buffer sizing closed the same loop: carrying 0.35 Mbps of critical traffic through the outage peaks at 434.7 Gb, which fits the 500 Gb store with 13% margin. Because conjunction sits right next to maximum range, the backlog then takes ~70 days to clear - slow drainage is geometry, not a fault.

The counter-example (the old card's assumption of a constant 2 Mbps intake): the buffer pins at capacity around day 70 and 84.8 Tb is lost over the cycle - more than the 65 Tb the link can deliver in the first place. At mission level, the 10 dB the review caught is worth the entire science return.

Where the occultation by-product actually lands (numeric solver and closed form agree digit for digit). An areostationary satellite is fixed in the Mars-fixed frame but circles Mars once per sol in inertial space, so whenever Earth areocentric declination |dec| < 9.64 deg it is occulted once per sol, and ingress and egress each yield a limb sounding - the radio-science by-product of the DTE link. Tangent longitude is pinned at the slot +/-80.4 deg (dec = 0) narrowing to +/-79.8 deg (dec = 3.07), i.e. set almost entirely by the slot; tangent latitude depends only on dec, as arcsin[(r/R)*c*sin dec], sweeping from the equator to 78N over one season. Consequence: the satellite at 77.4E samples air at 157.8E and 357.0E - never the city beneath it. Sampling the city requires a second satellite sitting at 77.4 +/- 79.8 deg. The eastern branch of the 157.2E slot tracks up the city meridian (dec 0 -> 0.0N/76.84E; dec 3.07 -> 18.40N/77.37E, an exact hit on Jezero; dec 9 -> 67.1N/92.7E), and the season covers 25.7% of the Mars year (~172 sols), one city-meridian profile per sol. Model scope: straight-line grazing geometry (Mars surface refractivity ~3.6 N-units bends the ray ~0.009 deg, negligible for slot selection), neutral-atmosphere reference altitude 25 km, no ionosphere.

pois.label: 太阳翼(SADA 对日跟踪)
pois.detail: 两侧各 3 板串联柔性桁架翼，单板 4×1.5 m，总展开约 30 m。三结砷化镓电池(深蓝格) + 白色背板 + 桁架臂，根部太阳翼驱动机构(SADA)绕根部轴缓慢转动对日跟踪，随卫星绕火一周旋转一周。火星轨道太阳常数约 590 W/m²(地球 1361 的 43%)，为全部载荷、TWTA 与蓄电池充电供电。
pois.detail_en: Three flexible panels per side on a truss yoke, 4 x 1.5 m each, spanning about 30 m tip to tip. Triple-junction gallium arsenide cells (the deep blue grid) on white backing, with the solar array drive assembly at the root turning the wings slowly to follow the Sun - one revolution per orbit. The solar constant at Mars is about 590 W/m^2, 43% of Earth's 1361, and this array powers every payload, the travelling-wave tubes and battery charging.

specs.BOL 功率: ≈6.3 kW(平均日心距)· 5.3–7.7 kW 远/近日

specs_en.BOL power: ~6.3 kW at mean heliocentric range, 5.3-7.7 kW aphelion to perihelion

pois.physics: 光伏:光子能量 hν 须 >带隙 E_g 才激发电子-空穴对;E_g 以下透明、以上超出部分热化损失 → 单结的 Shockley-Queisser 上限 ~33%(最佳 E_g≈1.34 eV)。三结(InGaP/GaAs/Ge ≈1.9/1.4/0.7 eV)分段吃不同波段,越过单结极限达 ~30%。火星光谱同地球 AM0(皆在大气外),辐照度按 1/r² 降到 ~43%,但环境低温反而略抬开路电压 V_oc。
pois.physics_en: Photovoltaics: a photon only makes an electron-hole pair if h nu exceeds the band gap - below it the cell is transparent, above it the excess thermalizes away, which is what sets the Shockley-Queisser ceiling of ~33% for a single junction (optimum gap ~1.34 eV). A triple junction (InGaP/GaAs/Ge at ~1.9/1.4/0.7 eV) slices the spectrum three ways and beats that limit at ~30%. The Martian spectrum is the same AM0 as Earth's, both being outside an atmosphere; only irradiance drops to ~43% by 1/r^2, while the colder environment actually lifts open-circuit voltage slightly.
sim: 功率(评审修正标签):590 W/m² 是平均日心距(1.524 AU)通量 → 36 m² × 0.30 ≈ 6.3 kW 为年均;火星轨道偏心率大(e=0.093),近日(1.381 AU,713 W/m²)7.7 kW、远日(1.666 AU,490 W/m²)5.3 kW,±20% 季节波动本身就是电源系统的设计输入。尘暴不影响轨道器(仅地面站受限)
星蚀:分点季(Ls≈0°/180°)每 sol 穿本影一次;火星张角 arcsin(3390/20428)=9.55°→最长蚀 (2×9.55/360)×88,642 s ≈ 78 min(略长于地球 GEO 的 72 min);太阳赤纬 ±25° 扫过,仅 |dec|<9.55° 时发生 → 每火星年两段蚀季
电池:蚀内满载 ~3 kW×1.3 h ≈ 3.9 kWh,80% DoD → 容量 ~5 kWh;GEO 式低循环(~90 次/年,15 年 ~1350 次)对锂离子很温和,寿命由日历老化而非循环主导
瞬态热实解(COMSOL 6.3 瞬态传热):阵温日照 −25°C,入影后按 T⁴ 辐射冷却,初速 −7°C/min,78 min 末跌至 −152°C → 每轨摆幅 127°C。这既是电池必需的根因(入影阵即死电),也是热疲劳驱动:电池片-互连-盖片(CIC)与 SADA 承受 127°C 深循环,15 年累计 ~1350 次(与电池循环数同源),CTE 失配疲劳成为寿命/鉴定驱动
辐射退化(接 bus 卡 Geant4 输运):电池片仅 ~100 µm 盖玻璃防护,基本承受全谱 SPE 质子 → 位移损伤降载流子寿命;三结 GaAs 在 Φ(>10 MeV)=5×10¹⁰ 下 15 年退化因子 ~0.86 → EOL 平均 ~5.4 kW。校核:EOL 远日最坏 ~4.6 kW 仍覆盖 3 kW 蚀季负载 + 充电,电源闭环在寿命末期依然成立
sim_en: Power (the review corrected the label): 590 W/m^2 is the flux at mean heliocentric distance (1.524 AU), so 36 m^2 x 0.30 = 6.3 kW is an annual mean. Mars has a large eccentricity (e = 0.093), so perihelion (1.381 AU, 713 W/m^2) gives 7.7 kW and aphelion (1.666 AU, 490 W/m^2) gives 5.3 kW - that +/-20% seasonal swing is itself a power-system design input. Dust storms do not touch an orbiter, only ground stations.

Eclipse: in the equinox seasons (Ls ~0 and ~180 deg) the satellite crosses the umbra once per sol. Mars subtends arcsin(3390/20428) = 9.55 deg, so the longest eclipse is (2 x 9.55/360) x 88,642 s ~ 78 min, slightly longer than Earth GEO's 72 min. Solar declination sweeps +/-25 deg and eclipses only happen while |dec| < 9.55 deg, giving two eclipse seasons per Martian year.

Battery: ~3 kW for 1.3 h in eclipse is 3.9 kWh, and at 80% depth of discharge that means ~5 kWh of capacity. The GEO-like duty (~90 cycles a year, ~1350 over 15 years) is gentle on lithium-ion - calendar ageing rather than cycling sets the life.

Transient thermal solution (COMSOL 6.3, transient heat transfer): the array sits at -25 C in sunlight and radiates as T^4 the moment it enters shadow, starting at -7 C/min and reaching -152 C by the end of the 78 minutes - a 127 C swing every orbit. That is both why a battery is mandatory (the array is dead the instant it enters shadow) and the driver of thermal fatigue: cell-interconnect-coverglass assemblies and the drive mechanism take 127 C deep cycles, ~1350 of them over 15 years (the same count as the battery cycles), which makes CTE-mismatch fatigue a life and qualification driver.

Radiation degradation (following the Geant4 transport on the bus card): with only ~100 um of coverglass the cells take essentially the full SPE proton spectrum, and displacement damage cuts carrier lifetime. Triple-junction GaAs under 5x10^10 p/cm2 above 10 MeV degrades by a factor of ~0.86 over 15 years, so end-of-life mean power is ~5.4 kW. Check: the worst case, end of life at aphelion, still gives ~4.6 kW against the 3 kW eclipse-season load plus charging - the power loop still closes at the end of the mission.

pois.label: 转发器 + 行波管(载荷核心)
pois.label_en: Transponder and travelling-wave tubes (the payload core)
pois.detail: 中继星的立命之本——射频载荷链:天线馈源→低噪放(LNA,定 G/T)→再生转发器(星上处理)→行波管放大器(TWTA,定 EIRP)→天线。采用再生(OBP)而非弯管:解调-纠错-重编码-重发,把'对火用户跳'与'对地跳'解耦,两跳各自独立选码率与调制,并支持 DTN 存储转发与星上包路由。Ka 返向 TWTA + X 波段 SSPA 双链,环冗余保成功率。
pois.detail_en: What the satellite exists for - the RF payload chain: antenna feed, low-noise amplifier (which sets G/T), regenerative transponder (on-board processing), travelling-wave-tube amplifier (which sets EIRP), antenna. Regenerative rather than bent-pipe: demodulate, correct, re-encode, retransmit, so the user hop and the Earth hop are decoupled and each picks its own code rate and modulation, and DTN store-and-forward with on-board packet routing becomes possible. A Ka return TWTA and an X band solid-state amplifier run in parallel, ring-redundant for availability.

specs.架构: 再生转发(OBP) · 星上解调重编码
specs.带宽: Ka 返向 ≈500 MHz(深空 31.8–32.3 GHz)
specs.服务能力: 单址高增益 ×2 · (可扩)多址相控阵

specs_en.Architecture: regenerative (OBP), demodulate and re-encode on board
specs_en.Service: 2 single-access high-gain beams, multi-access phased array as growth
specs_en.Mass storage: several hundred Gb (buffering and peak shaving)

physics: 热噪声地板:N=kTB(Johnson-Nyquist)——接收前端载流子的热扰动产生功率谱密度 kT,与频率无关(直到 hf~kT);链路预算里的 '+228.6' 就是 10log(1/k),k=1.38×10⁻²³ J/K。
系统噪声温度:T_sys=T_天线+T_接收机;天线温度就是波束'看'到的东西——指向冷空是 CMB 2.7 K,擦到火星/地面则升到 ~200 K。故品质因数是 G/T:要高增益 + 冷接收机(低噪放),而非单看增益。
香农天花板:C=B·log₂(1+S/N) 是硬极限;LDPC/Turbo 码距它仅 ~1–2 dB,而低于门限 Eb/N₀ 时再好的码也救不回——这是物理悬崖,不是工程裕度。(该声明已被实测:见 sim 蒙卡 BER 瀑布)
体制边界:射频受 kT 热噪声限;光通信受单光子能量 hf 限(泊松光子统计,量子极限)。跨代深空光通信是'光子饥饿'问题,不再是热噪声问题。
physics_en: The thermal noise floor: N = kTB (Johnson-Nyquist). Thermal agitation of carriers in the receiver front end produces a power spectral density of kT, independent of frequency until hf approaches kT - and the '+228.6' in every link budget is simply 10 log(1/k) with k = 1.38x10^-23 J/K.

System noise temperature: Tsys = Tantenna + Treceiver, and antenna temperature is whatever the beam is looking at - 2.7 K of CMB on cold sky, ~200 K if it grazes Mars or the ground. That is why the figure of merit is G/T: high gain and a cold receiver, not gain alone.

The Shannon ceiling: C = B log2(1 + S/N) is a hard limit. LDPC and turbo codes sit only 1-2 dB from it, and below the threshold Eb/N0 no code recovers anything - a physical cliff, not an engineering margin. (Claim since measured: see the BER waterfall Monte Carlo below.)

Where the regimes end: radio is limited by kT thermal noise, optical communication by the single-photon energy hf (Poisson photon statistics, the quantum limit). Next-generation deep-space optical links are a photon-starvation problem, no longer a thermal-noise one.
sim: EIRP 闭环:40 W = 16 dBW + 58 dBi(Ø3 m Ka) = 74 dBW,与 ka 卡自洽;HFSS 扫频实测馈源 S11 −26.6 dB(失配损耗 0.01 dB)→ 该预算把『增益=实现增益』当默认,现被仿真证实成立
吞吐(评审修正):150 Mbps 是功率/用户 EIRP 受限,不是带宽受限——500 MHz 分配下仅占用 ~0.3 bit/s/Hz(带宽上限本可到 ~1 Gbps);瓶颈在用户上行 EIRP 与本星 G/T 的乘积,余下频谱是升级余量
热耦合:40 W RF @63% 效率吃 ~64 W 直流、耗散 ~24 W,构成热控主热源(见 thermal 卡);再生比弯管多耗数字处理功耗但省下行链路裕度
多址与可用度:2 副 Ø3 m 为单址高增益(一次跟踪一个高速用户);海量低速信标宜配多址相控阵同时成多波束(TDRSS MA 式)。可用度 = 几何可见(星座保证)× 链路(仰角)× 调度争用;超订时按优先级排程,DTN 缓存削峰

调度实测(事件驱动 M/G/2 优先级排队,6 用户机队 30 sol,含 120 s 换向开销):静止轨道意味着足印内用户永远可见——『接触调度』在这里不是找窗口而是天线分时。标称机队仅占用碟时 9.2%、排队为零;容量拐点在 ~11× 机队增长(供给=100%);过载 ×32 时优先级保护依然有效——乘组关键流仍 ~3 分钟,科学批量流已排到数天。结论:多址相控阵的理由是『多用户同时在线的时延』,不是吞吐——吞吐余量还有 10×
体系不对称(任务级仿真量化):Ka 用户链可突发 150 Mbps,而对地干线全周期均值仅 0.965 Mbps——用户侧超配 ~150×。这不是浪费:'快收慢送'正是中继体系的本质,星上存储是两者间的变速箱;但它也意味着科学产出的硬顶是对地干线(65 Tb/会合周期),加用户天线不涨产量,加 DTE 口径/功率才涨

编码蒙卡实测(rate-1/2 规则(3,6) LDPC n=2040,归一化 min-sum 50 迭代,全零码字法):瀑布在 2.0 dB 过 BER 10⁻⁴——距香农极限(rate-1/2 BPSK 0.19 dB)实测 1.8 dB,编码增益 6.4 dB;『距香农 1–2 dB』声明用最朴素的规则码就落在上沿,DVB-S2/CCSDS 非规则码可进到 0.6–1 dB。副产品:简易 Gallager 构造未消 4-环,2.5 dB 处现出误码地板——这正是工程上要用 PEG/准循环构造的原因
sim_en: EIRP closure: 40 W = 16 dBW plus 58 dBi (dia. 3 m Ka) = 74 dBW, consistent with the Ka card; the swept HFSS result of -26.6 dB feed S11 (0.01 dB mismatch loss) confirms the budget's implicit assumption that realized gain equals gain.

Throughput (review correction): 150 Mbps is limited by power and user EIRP, not by bandwidth - it occupies only ~0.3 bit/s/Hz of the 500 MHz allocation, which could carry ~1 Gbps. The bottleneck is the product of user uplink EIRP and this satellite's G/T; the rest of the spectrum is upgrade headroom.

Thermal coupling: 40 W of RF at 63% efficiency draws ~64 W DC and dissipates ~24 W, the dominant heat source for thermal control (see the thermal card). Regenerative processing costs more digital power than a bent pipe but buys back downlink margin.

Multiple access and availability: the two dia. 3 m dishes are single-access high-gain, tracking one fast user at a time; a swarm of low-rate beacons would want a multi-access phased array forming many beams at once, TDRSS style. Availability is geometric visibility (guaranteed by the constellation) x link quality (elevation) x scheduling contention, and when oversubscribed, priority scheduling plus DTN buffering shaves the peaks.

Scheduling measured (event-driven M/G/2 priority queue, six-user fleet over 30 sols, 120 s slew overhead included): an areostationary slot means users inside the footprint are always visible - contact scheduling here is not window-hunting but dish time-sharing. The nominal fleet uses 9.2% of dish time with zero queueing; the capacity knee is ~11x fleet growth (supply fully consumed); at 32x overload priority protection still holds - crew-critical traffic still lands in ~3 minutes while bulk science has slipped to days. So the case for a multi-access phased array is latency with many simultaneous users, not throughput - throughput still has 10x of headroom.

System asymmetry (quantified by the mission-level simulation): the Ka user link can burst at 150 Mbps while the Earth trunk averages 0.965 Mbps across the cycle - the user side is over-provisioned ~150x. That is not waste: collect fast, ship slow is the essence of a relay, and on-board storage is the gearbox between them. But it also means the hard ceiling on science return is the Earth trunk (65 Tb per synodic cycle) - adding user antennas does not raise output, only a bigger or hotter DTE does.

Coding Monte Carlo (rate-1/2 regular (3,6) LDPC, n = 2040, normalized min-sum, 50 iterations, all-zero codeword method): the waterfall crosses BER 10^-4 at 2.0 dB - 1.8 dB from the rate-1/2 BPSK Shannon limit of 0.19 dB, a coding gain of 6.4 dB. The '1-2 dB from Shannon' claim lands on the upper edge with the most naive regular code; irregular DVB-S2 or CCSDS codes reach 0.6-1 dB. A by-product: the simple Gallager construction leaves 4-cycles in place and an error floor appears at 2.5 dB - exactly why real designs use PEG or quasi-cyclic constructions.

pois.label: 姿控与精指向
pois.detail: 0.226° 的 Ka 窄波束(HFSS+PO 实测)是姿控的驱动需求。三轴稳定、对火星天底保持指向(随卫星绕火每恒星日偏航转一周,使天底面常朝下、太阳翼常朝日)。星敏感器 arcsec 级定姿 + 反应轮控制 + 对地天线万向架精指。非对称太阳翼受太阳光压产生长期力矩,动量累积致飞轮饱和,需定期卸载。
pois.detail_en: The 0.226 deg Ka pencil beam (solved with HFSS plus physical optics) is what drives attitude control. The satellite is three-axis stabilized on Mars nadir, yawing once per sidereal day so the nadir face stays down and the wings stay sunward. Star trackers give arcsecond attitude knowledge, reaction wheels do the control, and the Earth antenna gimbal does its own fine pointing. Solar pressure on the asymmetric wings applies a secular torque, so momentum accumulates and the wheels need periodic desaturation.

specs.稳定方式: 三轴 · 天底指向 · 偏航跟踪
specs.执行机构: 反应轮 ×4(金字塔) + 推力器卸载

specs_en.Actuators: 4 reaction wheels (pyramid) plus thrusters for unloading
specs_en.Pointing requirement: better than 0.046 deg (~1/5 beam, holds 0.5 dB)

pois.physics: 角动量守恒 + 陀螺力学:反应轮存角动量 L=Iω,要转卫星就反向加速轮子(内部力矩不改总角动量,故靠交换而非凭空产生)。太阳光压对非对称太阳翼施加长期力矩 → 角动量单调累积 → 轮子饱和。定姿精度由星敏的光子噪声极限决定(星点质心提取 + 星表匹配,~arcsec)。火星无全球磁场 → 用不了磁力矩器,只能靠推力器卸载动量。
pois.physics_en: Angular momentum and gyro mechanics: a reaction wheel stores L = I omega, and turning the spacecraft means spinning the wheel the other way - internal torques cannot create total angular momentum, only exchange it. Solar radiation pressure on asymmetric wings applies a secular torque, so momentum accumulates monotonically until the wheels saturate. Attitude knowledge is set by the photon-noise limit of the star tracker (centroiding star images against a catalogue, ~arcsec). With no global magnetic field at Mars there are no magnetorquers - momentum can only be dumped with thrusters.
sim: 指向预算(经仿真+评审两轮收紧):主瓣指向损耗 L≈12(e/θ₃dB)² dB;波束 0.226° 时 0.06° 偏差已损 0.85 dB,压到 0.5 dB 须 e ≤ 0.046°(≈1/5 波束)——比手算时代(0.1°)整整严一倍多;误差项(星敏噪声+热变形+天线对准+抖动)逐项 RSS 分配。热变形项已被热弹实解落数:CFRP 碗自身热致视轴偏转仅 1.4×10⁻⁵°,可忽略——该项的真实来源是撑杆/母舱结构热弯,不是反射面
动量管理:火星无可用磁场(无磁力矩器),太阳光压对非对称翼的长期力矩只能靠推力器卸载 → 与 skeep 卡共用推进,计入 ΔV/寿命预算

控制-结构耦合(COMSOL 特征频率实解,评审校准精度):实心铝板代理解出一阶挠性模态 0.119 Hz——但该代理比真实柔性翼重 ~15×,真实桁架/张紧毯式翼的一阶模态可落在 0.05–0.3 Hz,只应引用『~0.1 Hz 量级』。结论类别不变:亚 Hz 挠性模态要求 ADCS 带宽压在 ~0.02 Hz 以下(且若模态落在低端 0.05 Hz,连 0.02 Hz 都嫌高,需陷波滤波)——30 m 大柔性附件是 ADCS 带宽的硬上限,不是天线指向精度
sim_en: Pointing budget (tightened by simulation and two review rounds): main-lobe pointing loss is L ~ 12 (e/theta_3dB)^2 dB, so on a 0.226 deg beam an error of 0.06 deg already costs 0.85 dB and holding 0.5 dB requires e <= 0.046 deg, about a fifth of the beam - more than twice as strict as the hand-calculation era (0.1 deg). The error terms (star tracker noise, thermal distortion, antenna alignment, jitter) are allocated by RSS. The thermal term now has a solved number: the CFRP dish itself deflects its boresight by only 1.4x10^-5 deg, negligible - the real source is thermal bending of the struts and bus structure, not the reflector.

Momentum management: with no usable magnetic field at Mars there are no magnetorquers, so the secular solar-pressure torque on the asymmetric wings can only be dumped with thrusters - shared propulsion with the station-keeping card, and charged to the same delta-V and life budget.

Control-structure interaction (COMSOL eigenfrequency solution, precision calibrated by review): a solid aluminium plate proxy returns a first flexible mode at 0.119 Hz - but that proxy is ~15x heavier than the real wing, and a real truss or tensioned-blanket array lands anywhere in 0.05-0.3 Hz, so only '~0.1 Hz class' should be quoted. The class of conclusion is unchanged: a sub-hertz flexible mode caps ADCS bandwidth near 0.02 Hz, and if the mode sits at the low end (0.05 Hz) even 0.02 Hz is too high and a notch filter becomes necessary. A 30 m flexible appendage is the hard ceiling on control bandwidth - not on antenna pointing accuracy.

pois.label: 热控(OSR 辐射面)
pois.detail: 把 TWTA 与电子学的废热倒进深空。背阳侧两块黑色石英镜(OSR)辐射面,高发射率 ε≈0.8、低太阳吸收比 α≈0.1,只看冷空、避开火星临边红外与太阳翼遮挡。热管把行波管热量导至辐射面。
pois.detail_en: Where the waste heat of the travelling-wave tubes and electronics goes: two black quartz-mirror (OSR) radiator panels on the anti-sun side, high emissivity (~0.8) and low solar absorptance (~0.1), seeing only cold sky and kept clear of Mars limb infrared and wing shadowing. Heat pipes carry the tube dissipation out to them.

specs_en.System dissipation: ~2-3 kW (bus at full load, essentially all electrical power)
specs_en.Operating temperature (COMSOL): -92 C at 125 W per panel (isolated payload-panel model)

pois.physics: 散热面为什么能工作 = 光谱选择性:普朗克黑体谱 + 维恩位移。太阳 5772 K,谱峰 0.50 µm;散热面 300 K,发射峰 9.7 µm——差约 20 倍。基尔霍夫定律逐波长要求 ε(λ)=α(λ),但工程上的 α(对太阳 0.3–2.5 µm 加权)与 ε(对红外 5–25 µm 加权)是两个不同波段的积分,故可 α≠ε。OSR 石英镜:α≈0.1(反射可见/近红外太阳峰)、ε≈0.8(发射红外)。被动面平衡温度 T=[α·S/(ε·σ)]^¼——压低 α/ε 才能冷,这是辐射器的第一设计参数。
pois.physics_en: A radiator works by spectral selectivity - Planck's law plus Wien's displacement law. The Sun at 5772 K peaks at 0.50 um; a 300 K radiator emits around 9.7 um, a factor of about twenty apart. Kirchhoff's law demands eps(lambda) = alpha(lambda) wavelength by wavelength, but the engineering alpha (weighted over the 0.3-2.5 um solar band) and eps (weighted over 5-25 um infrared) are integrals over different bands, so alpha need not equal eps. An OSR quartz mirror reflects the visible and near-infrared solar peak (alpha ~0.1) while emitting in the infrared (eps ~0.8). A passive surface settles at T = [alpha S / (eps sigma)]^(1/4) - pushing alpha/eps down is the first design parameter of any radiator.
sim: 排热能力:OSR 在 300 K 净排热 q≈εσT⁴−α·S ≈0.8×459 − 0.1×590 ≈ 300 W/m²(背阳);这是 300 K 下的『能力』上限,非工作点
有限元实解(COMSOL 6.3,传导+面对空辐射):单板 125 W → 能量闭合(排热 125.003 W ✓),辐射面自洽稳定在 −92°C(181 K),实排 49 W/m²、TWTA 基板 −82°C、热点到边缘梯度仅 13 K(铝导热充分,扩散不需热管)

结论修正(独立评审):我先前由 250 W 孤立模型得出『严重过冷、约束翻转』——但这与本星自己的功率账矛盾:母舱满载耗散 ~3 kW(电功率几乎全部变热,仅 ~60 W 以射频离开),3 kW ÷ 5.1 m² = 588 W/m² > 367 W/m² 能力上限 → 系统级看辐射面反而偏小 ~1.6×,需 ~8–10 m²(或百叶窗调节)+ 蚀内区域加热器。教训:建模边界即结论边界——单块载荷板『过冷』与整星『偏小』同时为真,把局部解读成全局才是错误
sim_en: Rejection capability: at 300 K an OSR nets q ~ eps sigma T^4 - alpha S ~ 0.8 x 459 - 0.1 x 590 ~ 300 W/m^2 on the anti-sun side - a capability ceiling at 300 K, not an operating point.

Finite-element solution (COMSOL 6.3, conduction plus surface-to-ambient radiation): one panel at 125 W closes on energy (125.003 W rejected), the radiator settles self-consistently at -92 C (181 K) rejecting 49 W/m^2, the TWTA baseplate sits at -82 C, and the hotspot-to-edge gradient is only 13 K - aluminium spreads heat well enough that no heat pipe is needed inside the panel.

Conclusion corrected (independent review): from an isolated 250 W model I had concluded the design was badly overcooled and the constraint inverted - but that contradicts this satellite's own power ledger. A fully loaded bus dissipates ~3 kW (nearly all electrical power becomes heat; only ~60 W leaves as RF), and 3 kW over 5.1 m^2 is 588 W/m^2 against a 367 W/m^2 ceiling, so at system level the radiator is ~1.6x too small and wants ~8-10 m^2 (or louvers), plus zone heaters through eclipse. The lesson: the model boundary is the conclusion boundary - 'this panel runs cold' and 'this spacecraft is radiator-limited' are both true, and reading the local result as global is the error.

pois.label: 位置保持与推进
pois.detail: 守住静止轨道槽位。火星三轴引力(Tharsis 隆起,强 tesseral 项)使势能随经度起伏,存在稳定/不稳定定点经度,卫星向稳定点漂移,需东西保持抵消;日引力摄动致南北(倾角)漂移。三卫星须锁定各自 120° 相位槽。推进兼作飞轮动量卸载。
pois.detail_en: Holding the areostationary slot. Mars's triaxial gravity field - the Tharsis bulge gives it strong tesseral terms - makes the potential undulate with longitude, so stable and unstable slot longitudes exist and a satellite drifts toward the stable ones; east-west control cancels that, while solar perturbations tilt the orbit plane and need north-south control. The three satellites each hold their own 120 deg phase slot, and the same propulsion doubles as reaction-wheel momentum unloading.

specs.东西保持: 抵消经度漂移(火星 tesseral 势)
specs.第三体: 火卫二轨道 23,460 km(略高)· 质量微不足道
specs.推进: 化学/电推 · 兼动量卸载
specs.余量裁决(2026-09-05): 采纳;8° 门限为泄压阀入册;不为余量动槽位;前提=槽 3 保持箱 ±0.25°

specs_en.Slots: radius 20,428 km, three equatorial slots 120 deg apart
specs_en.Third bodies: Deimos orbits at 23,460 km (slightly higher), mass negligible
specs_en.Propulsion: chemical or electric, doubles as momentum unloading
specs_en.Coverage margin (largest gap 140.1 deg): 10 deg mask: 0.55 deg (seam elevation 10.29) / 8 deg mask: 4.4 deg
specs_en.Margin ruling (2026-09-05): Accepted; 8 deg mask on record as relief valve; slots stay; premise = slot-3 box +/-0.25 deg

pois.physics: 引力势的物理:火星非点质量,其引力势按球谐展开——J2(扁率)+ tesseral 项 C₂₂/S₂₂(赤道椭率,源于 Tharsis 隆起)。经度相关的 tesseral 势像单摆一样对静止槽位产生回复/失稳力矩 → 存在稳定与不稳定平衡经度(类比地球 GEO 的 75°E/105°W 势阱)。日引力梯度使轨道面进动 → 倾角漂移。位保本质就是持续对抗这套'地势起伏 + 三体摄动'。
pois.physics_en: The gravitational potential in detail: Mars is not a point mass, and its potential expands in spherical harmonics - J2 for oblateness plus the tesseral C22/S22 terms for equatorial ellipticity, which come from the Tharsis bulge. The longitude-dependent tesseral potential acts on a stationary slot like a pendulum, restoring or destabilizing, so stable and unstable equilibrium longitudes exist - the analogue of the 75E and 105W wells at Earth GEO. Solar gravity gradient precesses the orbit plane and drifts inclination. Station keeping is nothing more than fighting that landscape and the third-body pull, continuously.
sim: 数值积分实解(scipy DOP853,J2+C22/S22 旋转引力场传播;方法先在地球 GEO 验证:算出最坏东西 ΔV=1.76 m/s/yr,与教科书 ~1.7–2 吻合 ✓):火星平衡经度四点——74.1°E/254.1°E 不稳定(Tharsis 轴)、164.1°E/344.1°E 稳定;最坏经度东西位保 33 m/s/yr,约地球 GEO 的 19×(C22 强 ~40× 的直接后果)
Jezero 槽位的运气:77.4°E 距不稳定平衡点 74.1°E 仅 3.3° → 漂移力接近零,东西位保仅 5.1 m/s/yr(最坏经度的 1/6.5)。代价:不稳定平衡=山顶,漂移指数增长,必须主动控制——但『需要持续控制』与『便宜』并不矛盾
南北:日第三体传播一火星年得 di/dt=0.083°/yr → 2.1 m/s/yr——仅地球 GEO(~50 m/s/yr)的 1/24,双重原因:无大质量卫星(月球贡献地球 2/3)+ 远日照(日摄动 ∝ n_s²,弱 3.5×)。火卫一/二质量可忽略
15 年总账:Jezero 槽位 (5.1+2.1)×15 ≈ 109 m/s vs 最坏经度 529 m/s——槽位选择本身就是 ~5× 推进剂预算;联氨(Isp 220 s)下 109 m/s 仅占干重 ~5%,电推则可忽略。ΔV × 比冲定推进剂质量,卡死在轨寿命

槽位经度选取(三槽全部立据,此前只有 77.4°E 有记录):槽位同时是三件事的杠杆——覆盖连续性、位保 ΔV、以及掩星切点落点。等分 120°(197.4/317.4)在前两项上并非最优,且掩星切点全部错开城市。改选 157.2°E + 297.3°E:①157.2°E 距稳定平衡 164.1°E 仅 6.9°,ΔV 从 26.0 降到 5.9 m/s/yr;②整星座东西位保 52.8 → 43.3 m/s/yr(净省 9.5,因为 297.3°E 被覆盖约束逼到漂移极大区 32.3,仍抵不过 157.2°E 的节省);③157.2°E 的掩星切点正落城市子午线(见 dte 卡)。代价:最大槽间隔 140.1°,10° 仰角门限上限 141.15°,计 ±0.25° 保持死区后余量仅 0.55°——这是拿覆盖裕度换科学,若门限放到 8°(上限 145.05°)余量回到 4.4°
sim_en: Numerical integration (scipy DOP853 propagating a rotating gravity field with J2 and C22/S22; the method was validated on Earth GEO first, returning a worst-case east-west 1.76 m/s/yr against the textbook 1.7-2): Mars has four equilibrium longitudes - 74.1E and 254.1E unstable (the Tharsis axis), 164.1E and 344.1E stable. Worst-case east-west keeping is 33 m/s/yr, some 19x Earth GEO, the direct consequence of a C22 about 40x stronger.

The luck of the Jezero slot: 77.4E sits only 3.3 deg from the unstable equilibrium at 74.1E, so the drift force is nearly zero and east-west keeping costs just 5.1 m/s/yr, a sixth of the worst longitude. The price is that an unstable equilibrium is a hilltop - drift grows exponentially and active control is mandatory. 'Needs constant control' and 'cheap' are not contradictory.

North-south: propagating the solar third body over one Martian year gives di/dt = 0.083 deg/yr, or 2.1 m/s/yr - a twenty-fourth of Earth GEO's ~50 m/s/yr, for two reasons: no massive moon (the Moon supplies two thirds of Earth's) and weaker solar geometry (the perturbation scales as n_s^2, 3.5x weaker). Phobos and Deimos are negligible.

The 15-year ledger: (5.1 + 2.1) x 15 ~ 109 m/s at the Jezero slot against 529 m/s at the worst longitude - slot choice alone is a ~5x propellant budget. On hydrazine (Isp 220 s) 109 m/s is only ~5% of dry mass; with electric propulsion it is negligible. Delta-V times specific impulse fixes propellant mass, and propellant mass fixes orbital life.

Slot-longitude selection (all three slots now justified; only 77.4E had a record before). Slot longitude is simultaneously a lever on three things: coverage continuity, station-keeping dV, and where the occultation tangent points land. Equal 120-degree spacing (197.4/317.4) is optimal for none of them, and its tangent points all miss the city. Choosing 157.2E + 297.3E instead: (1) 157.2E sits only 6.9 deg from the stable equilibrium at 164.1E, cutting that slot from 26.0 to 5.9 m/s/yr; (2) fleet east-west keeping drops 52.8 -> 43.3 m/s/yr (net 9.5 saved, since the coverage constraint forces 297.3E into a drift maximum at 32.3 m/s/yr, which the 157.2E saving still outweighs); (3) the 157.2E tangent point lands on the city meridian (see the dte card). The price is coverage margin: the largest slot gap becomes 140.1 deg against a 141.15 deg limit at a 10-degree elevation mask, leaving only 0.55 deg once a +/-0.25 deg station-keeping deadband is counted. Relaxing the mask to 8 deg (limit 145.05) restores 4.4 deg of margin.
